say: Hi, I'm Yefry Núñez, a twenty-seven-year-old software and AI developer from San Antonio de Guerra, a small town in the Dominican Republic.
I was raised by one parent, in a rural community with few opportunities, where money was a regular worry. I paid for my university studies by selling door to door across the country.
That taught me perseverance, and it is why I build technology for people who are usually left out.
I created Contractor AI, which flags unusual prices in public contracts, and 3R VideoGame, which teaches children about climate change.
tts: I created Contractor A I, which flags unusual prices in public contracts, and Three R Video Game, which teaches children about climate change.

say: They took me from Guerra to winning HackCorruption in Bogotá, to recognition from the Organization of American States, and to the top twenty of the United Nations' ITU.
tts: They took me from Guerra to winning HackCorruption in Bogotá, to recognition from the Organization of American States, and to the top twenty of the United Nations' I T U.

say: But people from backgrounds like mine rarely have a network to turn to.
I want to join the Fortis Fellowship to learn from leaders who also come from humble beginnings, across sectors and continents.
I want mentors and peers who challenge my ideas, and help me turn my projects into lasting institutions in government and public policy.
And I want to give back, sharing what I have learned about using AI for transparency with others who are building their own path.

say: Meeting the cohort in Medellín, in the region I want to serve, would mean a lot. Thank you.
